text:
Maya: Morning — quick async standup for gateway/routing/auth/rate limits
- Did: rolled authz patch to staging, exercised /v1/generate, latency looks stable. :rocket:
- Blocker: seeing intermittent 429s once we ramp >400 rps to the canary. Appears to be ingress rate limiter + per-route token-bucket double-counting.
- Today: triage 429s, add more granular metrics, small PR to change rate key, and coordinate canary bump. Ping @Omar for canary logs.

Omar: On it. Pulling canary logs now and will grep token-bucket keys. If it's double-counting the key might include an extra query param. Can you paste a repro curl? :eyes:

Maya: ```bash
# quick repro against staging canary
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -X POST https://staging-gw.redwood/api/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```

Li: I merged a routing-policy tweak earlier that avoids duplicate policy evals when a route has both host and path rules. PR #8345 https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/8345 — could be related if two policy evaluations each increment a bucket. pls review when you have a sec.

Priya: Scheduled the canary bump for 11:30 PT and added a short watch: SLO alerts wired to #eng-sre and my phone. If errors > 3% in 5m I will rollback automatically. Will also enable expanded token/bucket histograms on the canary. :alarm_clock:

Jenna: Quick note — if this escalates, follow paging playbook and tag @eng-oncall. Also remind folks to add the smokecheck (simple generate + 200 check) to the canary job before pushing wide.

deploy-bot: Deploy started for canary 2026-03-17-1130 (id c-20260317-1130)

Omar: Found a mis-key in the token-bucket key (we were including the entire query string). Pushing a tiny patch to staging to normalize the key (strip query). Will validate logs in ~2m. :construction_worker_man:

Maya: Thanks — I'll watch dashboards. If 429s persist I'll rollback and open a short postmortem with timeline. :thumbsup:

Priya: ping me when patch is in so I can trigger the canary watch.

Omar: Patch applied to staging, canary logs show token-bucket keys normalized now. No 429s in the last 60s on the test traffic.

Maya: confirmed — traffic looks clean on tracing and no 429 spikes. Closing loop for now. Will follow up with a small post-deploy note in the runbook.

Jenna: Nice catch, team. Please add a one-line note in the PR about the root cause for future reference.

Maya: will do.
